caption: EnvArt CADMCP memory for deterministic DXF inspection: run cad_health, inspect layer names and entity counts, audit the DXF, then translate walls, openings, columns, axes, text, dimensions and title block into a source-truth report before any board styling or image2 prompt.
positive_aesthetic_notes: CAD inspection becomes the first design layer, not a back-office afterthought
semantic layer reports prevent pretty boards from hiding wrong plan topology
source truth can be converted into clean analysis overlays without redrawing the base plan
negative_failure_notes: do not beautify a plan before reading units, scale, walls, openings and dimensions
avoid copying layer 0 habits into the training target
do not let diagram arrows cover missing wall/opening errors
text_accuracy_notes: Keep layer names, room names, dimensions and title-block text editable and UTF-8 safe; do not convert ordinary annotations into vector glyph outlines.
layout_notes: Report order: source path, unit/scale, layers, entity counts, locked geometry, uncertain geometry, repair actions, visual-overlay plan.

caption: EnvArt CADMCP memory for DWG batch workflows: prefer AutoCAD Core Console for repeatable DWG open, DXFOUT, plotting, script execution and non-interactive QA. Keep original DWG read-only and store converted DXF, previews, metadata and captions in a separate corpus or delivery directory.
positive_aesthetic_notes: Core Console keeps CAD processing repeatable and reduces interactive errors
read-only source isolation protects project drawings from accidental edits
conversion metadata helps later board prompts preserve drawing provenance
negative_failure_notes: do not run destructive edits on original DWG sources
do not judge a converted plan only by preview image quality
avoid losing title blocks and dimensions during visual simplification
text_accuracy_notes: Preserve drawing names, drawing numbers, revision notes, scales and title-block fields as explicit metadata.
layout_notes: Use a processing manifest before visual composition: original DWG, script, converted DXF, audit output, preview, known limitations.

caption: EnvArt CADMCP memory for Tianzheng architecture workflows: when Tianzheng is available, prefer architectural component commands for walls, openings, columns, axes, rooms, stairs and annotation over primitive decorative linework. Treat doors and windows as hosted openings, not symbols pasted on unbroken walls.
positive_aesthetic_notes: Tianzheng component logic keeps architecture drawings closer to professional practice
hosted openings make later diagram overlays and construction QA more reliable
semantic building components improve both CAD output and board explanation
negative_failure_notes: do not draw a door arc over an unbroken wall
do not classify beams or height labels as walls without checking thickness and continuity
avoid hand-drawn primitive geometry when building components are required
text_accuracy_notes: Use editable room names, opening numbers, axis labels and dimensions; uncertain raster-traced openings must be marked inferred.
layout_notes: Drawing order: axes, outer envelope, structural walls, columns, interior walls, explicit openings, doors/windows, stairs, furniture/equipment, dimensions, annotation.

caption: EnvArt CADMCP memory for construction drawing QA: validate plan, reflected ceiling plan, elevation, section, detail and node drawings with semantic layers, editable text, dimensions outside crowded geometry, material notes, elevation markers and detail indexes before generating polished boards or deliverables.
positive_aesthetic_notes: construction-level clarity is an aesthetic value because it makes spatial intent inspectable
semantic lineweights and editable annotation create professional drawing order
QA separates source geometry errors from board composition issues
negative_failure_notes: do not hide missing dimensions behind clean visual styling
avoid overlapping text, dimensions, leaders and geometry
do not treat construction notes as decorative texture
text_accuracy_notes: Room names, scales, material names, dimensions, elevations and detail indexes must be short, readable, correctly encoded and editable.
layout_notes: QA output should group issues by geometry, layer, annotation, dimension, title block, and drawing-set completeness.

caption: EnvArt CADMCP memory for image2 plan-fidelity prompts: uploaded CAD, plan, section or model screenshot is the source of truth. Lock aspect ratio, north, entrance, wall topology, columns, openings, axes, scale and source line hierarchy; add analysis colors, arrows, hatches and labels as overlay layers only.
positive_aesthetic_notes: image2 prompts become safer when CAD locks are named before visual style
analysis overlays can be beautiful without altering the base plan
competition boards read better when plan fidelity and visual hierarchy cooperate
negative_failure_notes: do not stretch, squeeze, crop or redraw the source plan casually
do not invent walls, roads, POI, doors or dimensions
avoid random decorative hatches that confuse construction meaning
text_accuracy_notes: Use exact verified labels or clean placeholders; no pseudo-Chinese, mojibake, fake room names, fake scale bars or fake north arrows.
layout_notes: Prompt order: source lock, allowed overlays, diagram purpose, color hierarchy, label rules, forbidden topology changes, QA checklist.

caption: EnvArt CADMCP memory for board composition: build an evidence chain from location, site boundary, circulation, users, problems, strategy, function, plan, spatial generation, axon or section, material and final render. CAD-derived base drawings stay locked while board modules explain design reasoning.
positive_aesthetic_notes: CAD truth and academic narrative can share one ordered board system
module hierarchy prevents dense technical drawings from becoming visual clutter
source plan, analysis overlay, axon, section and render each need a distinct role
negative_failure_notes: do not use renders to compensate for missing plan logic
avoid stacking too many tiny diagrams without one dominant anchor
do not mix commercial poster drama with academic evidence-chain clarity unless requested
text_accuracy_notes: Board titles, module labels, legends and captions must be concise and verified; keep dense notes outside the drawing core.
layout_notes: Suggested order: title and thesis, source audit, site/context, analysis overlays, spatial generation, axon/section, material/render, QA and delivery notes.
